operations.premise: ___raise_interrupt_vmstate iterates processor states and calls this writer; the global heartbeat/registry path permits another processor to be targeted. Expansion samples stack_start then publishes stack_trip. Its trailing shared-memory barrier does not bind that sample to the current section generation.
Owner writes stack_limit from alloc_stack_limit, fudge, stack pointer and available heap before refreshing interrupts and resuming. Source grep finds no other actual stack_limit field assignment.
Darwin GNU successor retains the trip comparison and separately checks current owner stack_limit. A delayed low trip can no longer suppress this condition.
Source contract requires reserve at least largest continuation frame; compiler target declares 4096 maximum frame slots.
Poll emission adjusts the represented frame pointer before evaluating POLL. This is source correspondence, not complete control-flow coverage proof.

openRequirements: The actual native sender/section-switch interleaving has not been traced.
The page-guard fault is before payload; it does not prove a write to header fields.
Arbitrary generated control-flow poll coverage, memory-model refinement and interrupt liveness are not proved by finite QNT.
Complete exact-source native inventories, fault/lifetime/GC-FFI, Gerbil and release qualification remain required.
